# MistriDako (মিস্ত্রি ডাকো)

> MistriDako is a home-service marketplace for Tangail District, Bangladesh. Customers book verified local professionals — electricians, plumbers, masons, painters, carpenters, AC technicians and more — through a coordinated booking flow: request a booking, approve an itemized quotation, then the professional completes the work. Tagline: এক ডাকেই, ঘরের সমাধান। ("Every home solution, in one call.")

Note: this file is a convenience summary for AI systems. It is not a replacement for the XML sitemaps (https://mistridako.vercel.app/sitemap.xml) and is not a guaranteed AI indexing method.

## Business category

Home services marketplace / local services platform (Bangladesh).

## Service area

Tangail District, Bangladesh only — 12 upazilas: Tangail Sadar, Ghatail, Kalihati, Mirzapur, Sakhipur, Basail, Madhupur, Nagarpur, Delduar, Bhuapur, Gopalpur, Dhanbari. MistriDako does not currently serve Dhaka or other districts.

## Services

- Electrician (ইলেকট্রিশিয়ান): https://mistridako.vercel.app/services/electrician
- Plumber (প্লাম্বার): https://mistridako.vercel.app/services/plumber
- Mason / Rajmistri (রাজমিস্ত্রি): https://mistridako.vercel.app/services/mason
- Painter (রংমিস্ত্রি): https://mistridako.vercel.app/services/painter
- Carpenter (কাঠমিস্ত্রি): https://mistridako.vercel.app/services/carpenter
- AC Technician (এসি টেকনিশিয়ান): https://mistridako.vercel.app/services/ac-technician
- Tile Worker (টাইলস মিস্ত্রি): https://mistridako.vercel.app/services/tile-worker
- Welding (ওয়েল্ডিং): https://mistridako.vercel.app/services/welding
- Cleaning (ক্লিনিং): https://mistridako.vercel.app/services/cleaning
- Glass & Aluminium (গ্লাস ও অ্যালুমিনিয়াম): https://mistridako.vercel.app/services/glass-aluminium
- Renovation (বাড়ি সংস্কার): https://mistridako.vercel.app/services/renovation
- Pest Control (পেস্ট কন্ট্রোল): https://mistridako.vercel.app/services/pest-control

Prices are not fixed online: after a booking request, the customer receives an itemized quotation (labour, materials, transport shown separately) and the price becomes final only when the customer approves it.
